purpose: Describe friction utilization AND observed contact slip; not a reward, task failure or zero-beta criterion
case: D PhysX-trained PPO evaluated in native CPU MuJoCo at mu0.7; N=1
wheel_resultant_reference: rho=norm(sum contact Ft_worldXY)/(mu*sum contact Fn); uniform isotropic mu; loaded wheel Fn>5N
future_per_contact_reference: elliptic condim3 rho_L2=norm(Ft_i/mu_i)/Fn_i; actual aligned MuJoCo pyramidal condim3 rho_L1=sum(abs(Ft_i/mu_i))/Fn_i
legacy_slip: Force-weighted RMS wheel-lateral speed at actual contact points with individual Fn>5N; count0 means unavailable, never rolling
persistence: Longest observed consecutive-positive sample span t[last]-t[first], singleton0; unavailable/unloaded gaps break runs; no extrapolation
comparability: Report L/R separately and show loaded/eligible denominators. Body beta, wheel headings, XY error and maintained speed remain separate task metrics. A small wheel resultant rho cannot rule out local saturation/slip.
physx_status: Old saved channels are normal-only; tangential forces absent. Low-level get_friction_data requires a new validated measurement; never zip its anchors to normal points by index.
mujoco_contact_reader_status: New read-only API passes25 actual MuJoCo fixture tests; NOT used to reconstruct absent contact forces in this historical D episode. Collect current cached solution in a new diagnostic with timing provenance.
